blocks.content: Exam traps test not just your knowledge, but your presence of mind and critical evaluation under time constraints.

items: Questions containing words like 'NOT' or 'EXCEPT' account for a significant portion of avoidable negative marks.
Distractor options often feature correct numerical values but incorrect units.
Never select Option A without reading Options B, C, and D first.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Always watch out for trick keywords like 'NOT', 'INCORRECT', 'ONLY', and 'ALL OF THE ABOVE'.
Differentiate between partially correct distractors and fully accurate options before marking answers.
Manage time efficiently by skipping disproportionately lengthy or ambiguous questions on the first pass.
Verify numerical units and operational signs carefully in quantitative and reasoning problems.
